fact: The Institute for Public Policy Research (IPPR), a Namibian think tank, published a review by ALT Advisory calling the government's draft Data Protection Bill 'not fit for purpose', saying the regulator's independence needs redrafting and offences and penalties need developing; a version went to the ICT ministry's consultation on 30 November 2022.
The NMT Media Foundation's director, as African Media Barometer rapporteur, publicly criticised the government's failure to make the Access to Information Act operative.
